description: Search for prices using Stripe's Search Query Language. Use when you need to find prices by status, currency, product, or other criteria with flexible query syntax.

inputSchema.description: Request model for searching prices in Stripe.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page (default is 10, maximum is 100).
limit.title: Limit

page.description: Pagination cursor for a specific page; omit for the first page. Use `next_page` from a previous response for subsequent pages.
page.title: Page

query.description: The search query string, adhering to Stripe's Search Query Language. This language supports features like exact matches, range queries, boolean operators, and searching by metadata. For detailed syntax, refer to https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language.
query.title: Query

inputSchema.title: SearchPricesRequest

name: search_prices

custom_unit_amount.description: Customer-adjustable amount config for this currency.
custom_unit_amount.title: Custom Unit Amount

unit_amount.description: Per-unit amount in cents for this currency.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Decimal per-unit amount for this currency.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

active.description: Whether the price is currently active.
active.title: Active

billing_scheme.description: Pricing scheme used to compute the price.
billing_scheme.title: Billing Scheme

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) when created.
created.title: Created

livemode.description: True if the object exists in live mode, false if in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

lookup_key.description: Lookup key for this price, if applicable.
lookup_key.title: Lookup Key

metadata.description: Key-value pairs attached to the object.
metadata.title: Metadata

nickname.description: A brief description of the price.
nickname.title: Nickname

product.description: ID of the product this price is associated with.
product.title: Product

recurring.description: Recurring billing configuration, if this is a recurring price.
recurring.title: Recurring

tiers.description: List of tiers for tiered pricing.
tiers.title: Tiers

transform_quantity.description: Rules for transforming usage quantities before billing.
transform_quantity.title: Transform Quantity

type.description: Specifies if the price is one-time or recurring.
type.title: Type

unit_amount.description: Unit amount in cents, if applicable.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

PriceTier.description: Represents a pricing tier for tiered pricing.

unit_amount_decimal.description: Decimal per-unit price for the tier.
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

up_to.description: Upper bound quantity for this tier.
up_to.title: Up To

PriceTier.title: PriceTier

interval_count.description: Number of intervals between each billing.
interval_count.title: Interval Count

trial_period_days.description: Default number of trial days when subscribing a customer to this price using trial_from_plan=true.
trial_period_days.title: Trial Period Days

usage_type.description: How usage is determined for metered billing.
usage_type.title: Usage Type

SearchPricesResponse.description: Response model containing the search results for Stripe prices.

data.description: An array containing up to limit price objects matching the search query. If no objects match the query, the resulting array will be empty.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: Whether or not there are more elements available after this set. If false, this set comprises the end of the list.
has_more.title: Has More

next_page.description: A cursor for use in pagination. If has_more is true, you can pass the value of next_page to a subsequent call to fetch the next page of results.
next_page.title: Next Page

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always has the value 'search_result'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL for accessing this search result endpoint ('/v1/prices/search').
url.title: Url

SearchPricesResponse.title: SearchPricesResponse

TransformQuantity.description: Rules for transforming usage quantities before billing.

divide_by.description: Number by which to divide the usage before billing.
divide_by.title: Divide By

TransformQuantity.title: TransformQuantity
